gherkin.scenario: Edit employee First Name to empty string
given: I am logged in as an administrator
when: I navigate to the Staff page
I clear the First Name field
then: The page should display 'Changes to employee record were saved'
The test employee's First Name should be empty

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The page should display '請填寫這個欄位'
The validation message should appear for the First Name field
